name: AirFlex
tagline: Wheelchair-accessible soft-shell chamber for tight spaces.
description: The OneBase AirFlex is the accessible chamber. Its taller profile and large door take a wheelchair or a seat, so entry is easy for anyone, and its short footprint fits rooms where a lie-down chamber won't.

highlights.title: Step in, roll in
highlights.body: Tall design and wide door accommodate a wheelchair or seated entry. Ideal where accessibility and floor space both matter.

highlights.title: Built to last
highlights.body: Triple-zip closure, protective outer cover and an internal metal frame that holds the structure when deflated.

highlights.title: Clear view, clean air
highlights.body: Three transparent viewing windows, internal pressure gauge, and an oil-free compressor filtering to 0.001 microns.

highlights.title: Safety first
highlights.body: Rapid-response emergency depressurisation valve; optional oxygen via mask or nasal cannula.

faqs.q: Are all hyperbaric chambers the same?
faqs.a: No. The main differences are pressure, size and construction material. Soft-shell chambers typically run 1.3–1.5 ATA; hard-shell chambers reach around 2.0 ATA.

faqs.q: How often should I do HBOT?
faqs.a: Most clients see the best results on a protocol of five sessions per week. The OneBase app guides frequency and duration for your goal.
